Description captured from video:
“High Protein Breakfast Hot Pockets!🍳🥓
Easy Meal Prep🔥By @_aussiefitness (Macros: Per Serving - 8 Total)
328 Calories
29.5gC | 8gF | 32gP Ingredients: 120g Diced Short Cut Bacon (can be substituted for beef bacon, turkey bacon or your bacon of choice)
6 Eggs & 150g Egg Whites (whisked - or 8 regular eggs)
400g Plain All Purpose Flour (Vetta Smart Plain Flour - can be substituted for self raising flour)
420g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt
2 Tsp Baking Powder
Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Salt & Black Pepper
160g Low Fat Grated Cheese (20g per hot pocket - Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese)
Chives Reheat instructions:
Microwave = 3 - 5 Minutes (flip half way)
Air Fryer = 5 - 10 Minutes 180C / 180F
Oven = 5 - 10 Minutes 200C / 400F IMPORTANT NOTES:
If you find yourself have trouble forming the dough from it being too sticky, start by adding the flour first then slowly add the yoghurt & mix it together. Depending on the yoghurt brand some contain less or moisture than others causing it to be stickier. If this happens slowly add more flour until you reach a consistency you can work with & make sure to add some flour to your hands as well. Follow @_aussiefitness for more recipes like this🔥 #breakfast #breakfastideas #hotpocket #cheese #foodie #mealprep #highprotein #lowcalorie #easyrecipes #gymfood #fatloss #weightloss #healthyrecipes”.

mealItem_1778508781394.instructions:
Description captured from video:
“Comment “sandwich” for 8 high-protein sandwich recipes. SHARE and SAVE the recipe if you found it helpful! 

Sandwich 1: Buffalo Ranch Chicken Sandwich Macros: 539Cal, 65gP, 11gC, 21gF (calculated using the @thekalo.app) Ingredients: 2 slices sliced bread (I used @carbonautbaking for their high protein, fibre, and low calories) 1 cup (135g) cooked shredded chicken breast ½ cup (120g) 0% plain Greek yogurt (I used @oikos for their creamy texture and taste) 1 tbsp (15g) light mayonnaise (I used @hellmannsmayonnaise) 2 tbsp (30g) buffalo sauce ½ tsp garlic powder ¼ tsp onion powder ½ tsp dried dill ¼ tsp dried parsley Pinch black pepper ¼ tsp salt Optional: 1 tbsp finely diced celery

Sandwich 2: Smoked Salmon Cream Cheese Sandwich Macros: 441 Cal, 55gP, 9gC, 16gF (calculated using the @thekalo.app) Ingredients: 2 slices sliced bread (I used @carbonautbaking for their high protein, fibre, and low calories) 1 cup (150g) chopped smoked salmon ½ cup (120g) 0% plain Greek yogurt (I used @oikos for their creamy texture and taste) 1½ tbsp (22g) light cream cheese, softened 1 tsp (5g) lemon juice ½ tsp dried dill ¼ tsp garlic powder Optional: 1 tbsp finely diced red onion Pinch black pepper Small pinch salt 


Sandwich 3: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Sandwich Macros: 624Cal, 74gP, 16gC, 25gF (calculated using the @thekalo.app) Ingredients: 2 slices sliced bread (I used @carbonautbaking for their high protein, fibre, and low calories) 1 cup (135g) cooked shredded chicken breast ½ cup (120g) 0% plain Greek yogurt (I used @oikos for their creamy texture and taste) 1½ tbsp (22g) light cream cheese, softened 2 tbsp (15g) grated light parmesan 1 tsp garlic powder ¼ tsp onion powder Optional: 1 tsp dried parsley ¼ tsp black pepper ⅛ tsp salt 


Instructions: Mix all filling ingredients in a bowl until smooth. Fold in the protein until fully coated. Layer between bread slices and enjoy. Store sandwich in an airtight container for up to 3–4 days. Any questions feel free to DM me or drop a comment! Follow @themealprepstop for easy, simple high protein meal prep ideas. #sandwiches #lowcalorie #quickrecipe #macrofriendly #chickensandwich”.
